recommendation: Proceed only to a small finite-mass convergence prototype before deciding whether to build. Genuine family observable extension, not a new independent family.
apparatus: One-dimensional underdamped particle on a periodic ring, constant unknown drag gamma, smooth strictly positive known T(x), no external force, independent stationary experiments. Measure local bath calorimetric entropy at positive mass; form its long-time mean or variance per time, then take m to zero. Background heat maintaining T is excluded.
coherent_shortcut: Correct limiting position diffusion and correct conditional mean entropy production a(x) are retained. Model the entropy record as the additive functional integral a(X_s)ds and compute its full occupation-time variance by solving the positional Poisson equation. This gives a positive, generally nonzero variance and the exact nonuniform-temperature mean.

correct_limit.anomaly: dA=a(X)dt+sqrt(2*a(X))dW_hat, with W_hat independent of W
correct_limit.calibration: Nonuniform-temperature stationary mean rates at varied profiles determine reciprocal gamma. All model means agree exactly throughout allowed gamma.
correct_limit.hidden: Long-time variance rates under nonuniform T. Same apparatus, additional measured fluctuation statistic.

independent_reference.coboundary_choice: Add (3/2)*Delta log(T) to obtain the cubic integrand h=(3*T-m*v^2)*v*T_prime/(2*T^2). Finite-mass stationary long-time first and second cumulant rates are unchanged by these endpoint terms.
independent_reference.method: Stationary Kramers forward generator plus cubic multiplication; solve stationary density and first derivative of the tilted eigenproblem, then obtain variance via its second derivative. Fourier x/Hermite sqrt(m)*v discretization; evaluate several positive masses and check convergence before extrapolating.
independent_reference.independence: No reduced anomaly drift/noise coefficient is inserted. Exact integration by parts accounts for the same-noise heat derivative before generator tilting.
independent_reference.unresolved: No numerical prototype has yet been run. Must verify mass/resolution convergence, covariance normalization and zero-gradient rate0. Do not claim verifier runtime or separation before that.

sources.title: Bo, Lim and Eichhorn (2019), Functionals in stochastic thermodynamics: how to interpret stochastic integrals
sources.evidence: Eq40b gives the anomalous drift and independent Wiener contribution after elimination of velocity.

sources.title: Celani et al. (2012), Anomalous thermodynamics at the micro-scale
sources.evidence: Eqs11-14 describe the kinetic anomaly, its fluctuation identity and why position paths alone do not determine its statistics.

archive_audit.distinction: Current r3 predicts stationary mean heat; no entropy cumulants.
Mean anomaly under anisotropic drag; no fast entropy martingale.
Finite-time heat differs from inner work by stored energy endpoints. Proposed long-time cumulants intentionally remove that mechanism.
Joint counter correlations from particle conservation, not velocity homogenization.
Bosonic interference correction to reservoir transfer variance, not classical fast-velocity entropy.
Active colored-force mean work over shrinking window; different limiting measurement.

peer: physics_review approves conceptual closure and exact cubic coboundary route; requires primary covariance derivation and finite-mass convergence before a build.
difficulty_risk: Potentially easy once an agent invokes the fluctuation relation or recognizes the conditional-mean substitution. Extra numerical complexity must not become the reason for failure. The mean-only starter should be complete and the public apparatus should not mention the anomaly or its noise.
